method: Actual Chromium UI controls with real fictional browser journal. IndexedDB reads only for persistence assertions. No domain state injection, except the existing intentional quota-failure test and clock-observation controls in the match recovery suite.

suites.name: canonical match journey
checks: Home: 13 fictional roster records, nine selected, zero inferred attendance.
Attendance: explicit absent/present change and bulk check-in preserve separate availability.
Lineup: empty start blocked, ineligible keeper change rejected with an error, seven unique places and a bench swap remain drafts.
Clock: skipped render ticks retain time; pause excludes three minutes; navigation never pauses; manual first-half ending preserves 23:40.
Half-time: seven-minute break and lineup staging add no time; the second half restarts at 25:00 with one committed lineup.
Recovery: reload retains the journal and requires explicit referee time plus unchanged-lineup confirmation.
Full time: wall-clock rollback leaves active time intact; added time keeps running; manual finish totals 49:52 and exact seven-place participation.
Persistence: event IDs survive reload; sequence and predecessor chain remain complete and unique.
Storage failure: injected quota failure shows unsaved state, preserves history, and retries the same event exactly once.
Concurrent tabs: stale projection stays quarantined with its reserved sequence; reloaded writes retain the winning action and predecessor chain.

suites.name: live scoring, corrections, vacancies and formats
checks: A goal retains its captured active time and scorer while the clock advances through entry.
Both own-goal directions change the correct score and preserve truthful team attribution.
Correction and compensating void retain original evidence and reasons without changing paused actual minutes or targets.
Injury preserves a 40-second vacancy; confirmed return stays on the bench until a reviewed replacement, and every player partition conserves actual active time.
5-a-side fixture creation, selection, saved profile/formation snapshot and valid 5-place draft preserve the original fixture and team duration.
11-a-side fixture creation, selection, saved profile/formation snapshot and valid 11-place draft preserve the original fixture and team duration.

suites.name: private role projections, media revisions, fixtures, records and durability

scenarios.name: 01-fixture-history
scenarios.detail: Create/reschedule/cancel preserve one identity and old played date; cancelled status survives reload.

scenarios.name: 02-training-evidence
scenarios.detail: RSVP does not check in; held expected session contributes 1/1, cancelled occurrence excluded independently.

scenarios.name: 03-snapshots-and-formats
scenarios.detail: Prepared profiles are unchanged after edit; 5- and 11-place formations save with distinct stable slots.

scenarios.name: 04-historical-results
scenarios.detail: A friendly win adds 3 points; corrected loss removes them with before/after audit; unknown participation remains null.

scenarios.name: 05-private-role-projections
scenarios.detail: Player sees own named rows only; responses leave attendance unknown; spectator has no private report/control or withheld derived score.

scenarios.name: 06-exact-photo-revision
scenarios.detail: Pending media stays private; exact approval publishes v1/v2, previous approved revision remains until replacement approval, removal blocks spectator retrieval.

scenarios.name: 07-private-ballot
scenarios.detail: No default +59 cutoff; explicit fictional +25; self excluded, one player changes own private revision, manager sees no ballot, latest valid vote seals under original deadline.

scenarios.name: 08-invitations-revocation
scenarios.detail: Individual invitation and season grant revocations retain audit and block old spectator gallery retrieval.

scenarios.name: 09-durability-stale-tab
scenarios.detail: Reload preserves accepted team document; stale second-tab write cannot overwrite it and retained rejected projection survives reload.

suites.name: durable planner settings and sticky position mode
checks: Explicit settings become confirmed only after the real browser journal save.
Actual fictional score changes enter adventurous mode and retain it when the lead falls with return-to-normal off.
Confirmed settings and sticky adventurous mode survive panel closure and a complete page reload.
An explicit manual reset is committed and remains normal after reload of the same match checkpoint.

separateChecks.plannerDurability: Seven tests use real Node SQLite journal transactions, rollback, CAS/quarantine and reopen; this is not SQLCipher or native device proof.

reentryRegression.fix: Each explicit local review entry has a fresh view revision, resetting the fictional role while opening the same retained journal.
reentryRegression.actualProof: Scenario06 switches from spectator through the explicit top-level Manager chooser, approves the retained original/replacement photo revisions, and confirms final removal/history. Scenario09 verifies saved document and stale-tab quarantine across reload.

limitations: These local fictional role controls do not prove server authorization. Parent-owned real HTTP role and controller suites provide separate authorization evidence.
Synthetic illustrations do not establish real photo picker, native upload or scanner behavior. Separate prior runtime evidence covers actual private processing.
Encrypted journal, native lifecycle/reboot/lock, OS authentication, notifications and phone installation still require physical iPhone/Android tests.
Q07 strategy remains an explicit fictional experiment; these checks do not approve unresolved product or privacy policy.
